caseNameFull: Attwood v. Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioners are allowed until March 12, 1996, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
